title: Officials impersonation and digital-arrest threats
summary: RBI reported impersonators using allegations about illegal parcels, money laundering and account restrictions to intimidate people. They solicit transfers, private banking information or installation of unverified apps. Independently contact your bank instead of complying with an unknown caller.

title: Fake lottery, remittance and government-contract fees
summary: RBI described fake winnings and remittances requiring processing fees, and government-contract offers demanding security deposits. Impersonators use fabricated RBI letters or email identities. Avoid transferring funds in response to unsolicited offers and report suspected impersonation.

title: Urgent KYC messages and credential theft
summary: Fraudsters imitate banks in calls or messages and threaten account blocking to obtain credentials through KYC links. Use your bank's official site or branch for verification. Do not disclose OTPs, passwords or PINs to callers.

title: Remote-access app installation requests
summary: RBI warned that criminals persuade customers to install remote-access software that exposes device data. Avoid installing unknown apps at a caller's request. This advisory does not establish that every screen-sharing tool or accessibility service is malicious.

title: UPI collect requests disguised as incoming money
summary: Fraudsters misuse UPI collect requests by claiming a PIN is needed to receive money. Receiving money does not require scanning a QR code or entering a payment PIN. Contact your bank promptly about transactions you did not initiate.
